analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We may use personal information we have collected or that you have provided to assist our non-affiliated third-party sites and mobile apps to select bank ads or offers that may appeal to you, display them to you and monitor your responses.

analysis.headline: Shares Data with Affiliates
analysis.quote: We may share the personal information we collect from and about you online described in this Notice (and subject to other legal restrictions and notices you may have received depending on your relationship with us) with: Affiliates and Subsidiaries of Bank of America , such as Merrill.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Online Activity
analysis.quote: Information about how you use and interact with our Sites and Mobile Apps (for example, activities on pages visited, links clicked or unique and measurable patterns such as keystrokes, mouse clicks and movements, swipes and gestures)

analysis.headline: Collects Your Geolocation
analysis.quote: Geolocation information (for example, for real time ATM or financial center location, upon request, or for fraud prevention)

analysis.headline: Collects Voice Queries
analysis.quote: Log information such as your search and voice to text queries in the mobile app

analysis.headline: You Allow Third-Party Account Access
analysis.quote: If you share your Bank of America user ID, password or other information about your accounts with others, we will consider that you have authorized any transaction or action initiated by using the access information you provide.

analysis.headline: Retains Data As Required
analysis.quote: We retain personal information for a period of time as required by laws and regulations and the necessary business purpose.

analysis.headline: Notice Updates Without Consent
analysis.quote: This Notice is subject to change. We update this Notice periodically to comply with the most recent federal and local laws.
